title: review-finding
description: Shared finding schema emitted by any reviewer dispatch. Root is an OBJECT with a single `findings` array; an empty array is a SUCCESSFUL zero-findings review, not a failure. The object root and the all-properties-in-`required` shape are mandated by OpenAI structured outputs (`--output-schema`), which rejects an array root with 'schema must be a JSON Schema of type object' and rejects a partial `required` with "'required' is required to be supplied and to be an array including every key in properties". Optional fields are therefore expressed as nullable, never as absent. Zero-byte/non-JSON output is a rung failure at the dispatch layer, not a schema violation.
